cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. We said the concert would bring the village together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then we'll sing together without microphones.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Half the audience has gone home for torches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Look at that. The village is already supplying its own light.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 hopes concert unites village and A3 proposes joint unamplified singing; A5 celebrates own light but authority is mostly prefixed rather than directing participation.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2 outage constructively; A5 uses B4 torch trip as contribution, but already supplying could suggest light present while people remain away.

relationship.evidence: B2 names outage and B4 explains departing audience helpful purpose, a plausible partner contribution.

heightening.evidence: A5 interprets B4 solution as hope fulfillment, valuable causality, but does not develop the practical leadership method.

specificity.evidence: A1 concert and village clear; B4 gone for torches versus A5 already supplying light needs careful temporal reading.
